function.arguments: {"message":"When two people from the same company each claim ownership of a workspace, Meridian doesn’t pick a side automatically. A human reviewer will pause any changes and ask your company for documentation—such as a statement from someone in a position of authority over both parties—to verify who should retain access. arguments.message: When two people from the same company each claim ownership of a workspace, Meridian doesn’t pick a side automatically. A human reviewer will pause any changes and ask your company for documentation—such as a statement from someone in a position of authority over both parties—to verify who should retain access. Once the appropriate proof is provided, the reviewer can make the necessary access changes. Either party can start this process by contacting support with their account details.
